normalized_matching_profile.description: Description 30A ESCAPES presents… “Mariglo,” a charming beach retreat tucked inside the gated community of Watersound West Beach. This beautifully styled 3-bedroom, 3.5-bath beach home sleeps 8 and features a screened-in porch, a chef’s kitchen, multiple living areas, and access to the zero-entry community pool. With 4 bikes included, nearby trails, and a private boardwalk leading to the beach, “Mariglo” is pet-friendly and perfect for families or groups of friends ready to create lasting memories. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Coastal Charm in Watersound West — Tucked inside this quiet, gated community with access to scenic boardwalks and nature trailsPet-Friendly Paradise — Bring your furry friend along for the adventure—perfect for tail-wagging beach strolls and shaded porch napsRoom to Relax — Sleeps 8 with 3 spacious bedrooms and a cozy bunk area, ideal for families or small groups4 Bikes Included — Cruise down 30A’s iconic paths to beaches, parks, and local hotspotsChef’s Kitchen — Outfitted with stainless steel appliances, gas range, and bar seating for 4—perfect for casual dining or entertainingMultiple Gathering Spaces — Main living area + upstairs lounge with sleeper sofa and TV for movies, reading, or game nightsScreened-In Patio Retreat — Dine alfresco or lounge with a book while your pup relaxes in the fresh airResort-Style Amenities — Enjoy access to the zero-entry community pool and private beach boardwalk to secluded Deer LakeOutdoor Extras — Rinse off under the outdoor shower, fire up the gas grill, and unwind in total comfort*** LIVING AREAS ***Step into a light-filled main living area that invites conversation and relaxation. The open layout blends stylish furnishings with everyday comfort. Upstairs, a second living area offers the perfect hangout zone for kids, teens, or quiet reading.First Floor:Spacious open-concept layout with flat-screen TV and plush seatingSeamless connection to kitchen and dining areasScreened-in patio with ample outdoor seating and a dining table for 4Second Floor:Additional living area with a sleeper sofa and flat-screen TV*** KITCHEN & DINING ***Whether you're preparing a gourmet meal or laying out snacks after a beach day, the beautifully appointed chef’s kitchen has everything you need. With multiple dining spaces—indoors and out—gathering together over great food is effortless and enjoyable.Stainless steel appliances including a gas rangeMarble countertops and abundant cabinet spaceBar seating for 4 at the kitchen counterDining table with seating for 6Al fresco dining for 4 on the screened-in patio—perfect for breezy meals outdoors*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***First Floor:Primary King Suite – King bed, flat-screen TV, En-suite with dual vanities and walk-in showerHalf Bath – Conveniently located powder roomSecond Floor:King Guest Suite – King bed, flat-screen TV, En-suite with single vanity and walk-in showerKing Guest Suite – King bed, flat-screen TVGuest Bathroom – Single vanity and shower/tub combo with hall accessBunk Area – Twin bunk with flat-screen TV*** OUTDOOR SPACES & AMENITIES ***Screened-in first-floor patio with cushioned lounge seating and dining for 4Gas grill perfect for evening cookoutsOutdoor shower for a quick refresh after sun-soaked beach daysLush natural surroundings and nearby boardwalks to explore*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Set in the quiet, gated community of Watersound West Beach, “Mariglo” offers peaceful seclusion while staying close to all the fun along 30A.Easy access to scenic boardwalks that lead to Deer Lake’s secluded white-sand beachShort stroll or bike ride to the zero-entry community pool4 adult beach cruisers included for exploring the neighborhoodMinutes from dining, shopping, and family fun at The Big Chill and SeagroveNear Seaside, Alys Beach, and Rosemary Beach*** PET-FRIENDLY ***Pets are not allowed on furniture, beds, or in the poolDogs must be crated when left unattended by guestsNon-refundable pet fee: $250 + tax*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased separatelyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentWaiver required to get access to the 4 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***
